description: Errors and warnings for a script, or for several, from the editor's language server, and whether each is clean. With no editor of this project open, so no language server of it to ask, a short headless engine compiles the scripts instead and the answer says checkedBy: engine: every error that stops a script compiling, with its line and no column, dependenciesWithErrors naming the other scripts that failed while it loaded, typesMissingFromTheClassCache naming a class the project declares that the engine could not resolve because the class cache lacks it, with staleAnalysis saying what rewrites the cache, and warnings null, since the engine reports warnings only to an editor. Each diagnostic carries its severity (error or warning), its message, and where it is as the editor shows it: line and column counted from 1, and endLine and endColumn just past its end. Diagnostics are checked against the project's own files, and the two that the files disprove are named rather than passed on: a member the class cache's file declares, or a project class it extends does, a method, property, constant, static function or enum member, comes back under contradictedByTheFile with the script declaring it, and so does one a diagnostic names alone as an external class member, read against the class it is looked up on in the line it is on; and a class this project declares that the diagnostic could not resolve comes back under typesTheEditorHasNotLoaded, with inTheClassCache saying whether a launched game would resolve it. staleAnalysis then says what to do, and for both states it is editor_rescan first: it asks the editor already running, starts nothing, and has cleared each in every reproduction measured. Two exceptions are named when they apply. For an enum member, constant or static function of a global class the reload comes first: in the one project that has reproduced a stale enum member, editor_rescan with reloadScript on the declaring script cleared it and a plain rescan did not. And an editor whose last scan wrote the class cache shorter than the file holds a list behind the files and writes it on every scan, so on that editor the rescan loads nothing and staleAnalysis says editor_launch restart instead. What follows differs: for a stale analysed type, editor_rescan with reloadScript recompiles the held copy and editor_launch restart is the last resort that costs a window; for a class missing from the cache, project_import refresh_classes rewrites the cache from disk at the cost of a short headless engine, which matters beside a running bench.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scriptPath.description: A script inside the project, a folder, or a list of either, such as "scripts/player.gd" or ["scripts/economy", "ui/shop.gd"]. A folder is its .gd files at any depth, skipping what the engine skips. One script is answered on its own. Several are answered together, with clean, errors and warnings for all of them: a script with nothing to report is named in nothingReported, and every other is answered under scripts in that same shape, including a script that could not be read, named with why while the rest are still asked about. Any number of scripts is one call, which reports progress as it goes.
